_comment: The starter projects the card builder offers (web/README.md, 'Starter content'), in the order the page lists them. name is the folder in projects/ and on the card; the rest is what the page shows. tests/test_starter.cpp opens every folder in projects/ through app/storage.cpp.

projects.name: TECHNO
projects.about: Driving groove techno: rolling bass, sparse stab, sidechain.

projects.name: DEEP
projects.about: Swung drums, FM4 electric piano chords, a walking bass, held pads.

projects.name: DUB
projects.about: One chord thrown into a long dark echo, breathing on an LFO.

projects.name: DRIFT
projects.about: WAVE POLY chords and a drone in the HALL; polymeter chimes.

projects.name: ELECTRO
projects.about: 808 kit, rubbery 16th bass with slides, a synced lead riff.

projects.name: NIGHT
projects.about: Am F C G on a detuned string pad, octave bass, gliding lead.

projects.name: BREAKS
projects.about: A synthesized break that changes bar to bar by chance.

projects.name: STEEL
projects.about: Straight breaks with ratchets, rolls and a driven reese.

projects.name: SMASH
projects.about: Drum chaos, random-order ghosts and rolls, a sparse melody.

projects.name: CHAOS
projects.about: BREAKS pulled apart: rolls down to 1/64 and constant mutation.
